item.tib: dpal mgon drag po'i bskul 'phrin thog mda' 'bar ba
item.coloph: dmu rigs sngags 'chang nyi ma'i ming can gyis brtsams pa …
item.note: this text has two versions: a long and a short one. see kgkc, which reads: dpal mgon brgyad bskul. ntkc reads dpal mgon drag bskul rgyas bsdus. ytkc reads dpal mgon lcam dral gyis bskul pa. appended is a page 736 (marginal title: drag sngags), followed by a page 347 (marginal title: mtshams gcod drag sngags); these contain mantras associated with the main text. compare katen, p. 116 (no. 012-28).
